edits.before: Grand Starfall online — your shoves become bot-lane invoices. The early lead must become the map now.
edits.after: His 6 beats yours: Death Mark plus Living Shadow bursts you and dodges the W lock. Respect the window.

edits.before: First item spike: the stun-spear rotation deletes squishies. Last call before scaling lanes wake.
edits.after: Lethality makes his assassinate-and-exit clean — hold Aegis for the mark and never duel at full energy.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: In 5v5s his single-target ult must dive through your team — your W-stun locks him on arrival, Aegis eats the mark, he dies first.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Check it before every step-up. - E Aegis Assault is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark: 120s at rank 1 — spend your Aegis AFTER the mark lands, not before. - Living Shadow (W) is 20s early: no shadow means no escape and half his damage — that is your all-in window. - E Aegis Assault is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: Pre-6 he is a squishy melee on 6s shurikens — W-stun each step-up and stat-check him before energy refills.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Once Aegis is spent his shadow combo has no answer for 22 seconds — at his lethality spike that duel is his, so leave.

At full build he takes side lanes, where Living Shadow (16s at max rank) and Death Mark make him nearly ungankable one-on-one. Don't chase into his shadow swap: match him only with Aegis up, or trade the map instead — your Grand Starfall crosses 5500 range to punish whatever his split leaves open.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: Vault him while Living Shadow is down: empowered-Q stun, E the shuriken answer, walk away clean.
